```plato

    // The periodogram power of one plane wave over the point set: the squared
    // magnitude of the sum of exp(2 pi i f . x), divided by the point count. A
    // Poisson process averages to one at every non-zero frequency, so a reading
    // below one means the pattern SUPPRESSES that frequency and a reading above
    // one means it carries it. Frequencies are in cycles per unit length.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Periodogram
    WavePower(frequencyX: Number, frequencyY: Number, points: Array<Point2D>): Number
    {
        var cosine = SumOf(points.Map(p => (p.X * frequencyX + p.Y * frequencyY).Turns.Cos));
        var sine = SumOf(points.Map(p => (p.X * frequencyX + p.Y * frequencyY).Turns.Sin));
        return points.Count <= 0 ? 0.0 : (cosine * cosine + sine * sine) / points.Count.ToNumber;
    }
```
